subject: Post-discovery: 30-minute product showcase — proposed attendee pairings & two timebands
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@muralix.ai>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@muralix.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-minute product showcase — proposed attendee pairings & two timebands

Hey Ethan / Rebecca —

Thanks again for a productive discovery yesterday. Quick recap (one-paragraph): you shared the roadmap priority around in-product summarization and low-latency inference for document-heavy workflows; the main constraints are (1) a strict P95 latency SLO with bursty traffic, (2) SOC2 evidence and audit logs for the pilot, and (3) a three-month pilot budget that needs predictable unit costs. Monica and I captured a short list of technical and security questions in the attached notes.

Next step: a 30-minute product showcase focused on the integration path and latency/operational tradeoffs. To keep this tight, we recommend a pairing of attendees (choose one):
- Option A (Product + Engineering): Ethan (Product) + one backend engineer (for integration questions)
- Option B (Product + Security): Rebecca (Product/Compliance) + your security lead (to walk the audit checklist)

Available 30-minute timebands (all times PT):
1) Tue, Oct 28 — 11:00–11:30 PT
2) Wed, Oct 29 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu, Oct 30 — 09:30–10:00 PT

If none of these work, share two windows that fit your stakeholders and we’ll prioritize. I’ve attached a short PDF with discovery notes and a one-page agenda for the 30-min showcase. Also included: a security checklist Monica suggested we surface ahead of the demo.

Attaching:
- muralix-discovery-notes.pdf (3 pages — notes + proposed agenda)
- security-reqs-checklist.xlsx (stub — items we’ll cover)

Calendly link if easier: https://calendly.com/redwood-sean/30min

Thanks — we’ll hold one of the slots until EOD Friday PT and then open it if we don’t hear back.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Sean — appreciated the succinct recap. Option A (Product + Engineering) sounds right for the first 30-min showcase; our backend lead (Jordan Park) should join to validate the integration notes.

Quick note on times: Oct 28 at 11:00 PT looks good for both of us. If Jordan can’t make it, we’ll fallback to Oct 29 at 14:00 PT. I’ll confirm Jordan by EOD tomorrow.

Also: can you include a short slide or demo snippet that shows how Redwood handles graceful degradation / model fallback? That’s high on our checklist for pilot acceptance.

Ethan
Ethan Blake

Hi Ethan — quick follow from my side on security prep. If you pick Option A (Product + Engineering) for the first run, please also invite your security contact to the invite or have them review the attached checklist beforehand — there are two items that usually need legal to sign off (data retention terms, audit log access).

For the demo content: we’ll include a short demo snippet showing model fallback and a slidesheet that maps latency profiles to cost tiers. I attached a one-page security checklist (spreadsheet) and a brief pre-demo ask:
- Confirm whether the pilot will use customer-managed keys (KMS) or Redwood-managed keys
- Share expected TPS for the first two weeks of the pilot (estimate is fine)

Attaching (already sent by Sean but re-attaching for clarity):
- security-reqs-checklist.xlsx (single-tab checklist)

I’ll join the demo to cover the SOC2/audit evidence path and hand off to Sean for integration details.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference

Great — locking in Tue, Oct 28 11:00–11:30 PT for Option A. I’ll send the calendar invite to the three of you once Jordan confirms; for now I’ve tentatively booked the slot on our side. Agenda (30 min):
0–5 min: quick context and success criteria (Ethan)
5–15 min: integration flow + SDK/endpoint demo (Sean)
15–25 min: latency/fallback patterns and runbook (Monica)
25–30 min: next steps / pilot kickoff checklist

Pre-demo asks (one-liners):
- Jordan: can you confirm whether there will be a sidecar or direct HTTP integration?
- Ethan: please share an estimated TPS range (peak vs expected) — helps us pick batching/window sizes for recommendations

If anything changes, flag here or send a calendar note. Looking forward to it.

—Sean
